title: AI-Driven Contribution Evaluation and Conflict Resolution: A Framework & Design for Group Workload Investigation

bias_targets.methodology: The proposed framework mitigates subjective rating inflation (generosity bias), strategic reciprocity, and popularity effects (halo effect) by applying bias-correction normalisation algorithms (such as AutoRating) and supplementing qualitative peer surveys with objective quantitative metrics derived from student artifacts, communication logs, and coordination records.

To counteract the inherent rating inflation and 'kindness bias' commonly observed when using Generative AI for evaluation, the paper's framework pairs subjective qualitative evaluations generated by Large Language Models with deterministic tool grading and normalized objective base measures.
